subject.title: fix(browser): stop screenshot vision-failure fallback from injecting raw base64

question: Should configured browser-vision failures permanently prefer a text-only session-safe error over the current raw-image recovery fallback?
rationale: The patch fixes a demonstrated session-state hazard, but it intentionally removes an existing fallback that can preserve screenshot visibility when a configured provider is unavailable.

options.title: Adopt text-only failure semantics
options.body: Confirm that preventing persistent image blocks outweighs retaining raw-image recovery, then require live after-fix proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve fallback behavior
options.body: Keep the raw-image fallback and pursue a narrower session-storage or history-normalization repair that prevents contamination without changing screenshot recovery.

recommendation.title: Adopt text-only failure semantics
recommendation.body: Confirm that preventing persistent image blocks outweighs retaining raw-image recovery, then require live after-fix proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: No reliable current-main browser-surface owner could be identified without the required history pass.
